summary: Frontend-only test of Prayer Hub (Rosary + 6 Chaplets) and Self-Defense follow-up + MovementBreakdown changes. Prayer hub flow: PASS end-to-end (hub renders Rosary + all six chaplets; tap into St. Michael advances bead-by-bead; end-state shows a 'Good work for today' card + 'Journal this' CTA that pushes to /journal with seed_title and seed_body; Sacred Heart end card shows a different, unique good-work string — uniqueness confirmed). Stick-figure removal: PASS (no SilhouetteAnimation imports anywhere; no suspicious silhouette SVGs in either /self-defense/session/[id] or /self-defense/play/[id]; MovementBreakdown card visible in player with sections 'MOVEMENT BREAKDOWN', 'HOW TO PERFORM' (numbered steps), 'CUES', and 'AVOID' rendered correctly per step). Completion + journal-seed: PARTIAL (player reaches sd-player-complete overlay, journal nav from both the player overlay and the completed-session detail page correctly carries seed_title and seed_body URL params with the prefilled discipline-name+date title and bullet-line body from buildSelfDefenseFollowUp). HOWEVER — the 'FOR TOMORROW' card itself is visually broken on BOTH /self-defense/play/[id] AND /self-defense/session/[id] because the components reference field names that do not exist on the FollowUp type returned by buildSelfDefenseFollowUp (src/utils/sd-followup.ts).

ui_bugs.component: Self-Defense FOR TOMORROW card (play overlay + session detail)
ui_bugs.issue: Field-name mismatch with FollowUp type. The card reads followUp.focus, followUp.duration_minutes, followUp.intensity, followUp.discipline_practice — none of which exist. The actual FollowUp shape (sd-followup.ts) is { focus_title, focus_description, duration_min, virtue, motto, journal_title, journal_body }. Live result on screen: focus title row renders empty; meta row shows 'Virtue · Discipline · min ·' (duration empty, no intensity text, trailing dot); 'Discipline practice' heading is shown but the body text under it is blank. Only the virtue value and the italic motto render correctly. Confirmed visually on sd_cd22e760126045 Boxing session after completion (player overlay AND /self-defense/session/sd_cd22e760126045 detail).

Missing data-testid 'sd-followup-card' wrapper (player has it, detail page does not). The detail page has sd-session-journal on the journal button but no testID on the followup card wrapper itself — testing/automation cannot easily target it.

issues: Because of the field-name bug above, the FOR TOMORROW card has dangling separators: 'Virtue · Discipline · min ·' (trailing ' · '). Even after the field-name fix, the meta row's formatting/separator template should be reviewed so empty fields don't leave orphan dots.

Apply the same four fixes to /app/frontend/app/self-defense/session/[id].tsx lines 241, 243, 248.

Decide whether 'intensity' should be derived from session.intensity_actual / session.plan.intensity in sd-followup.ts (recommended — already computed in buildSelfDefenseFollowUp internally as `intensity` for the journal_body, just not exposed on the returned FollowUp). Suggest extending the FollowUp type with an `intensity` field and including it in the returned object so the UI text 'duration + intensity' line populates.
(Low) Add a data-testid='sd-followup-card' wrapper to the FOR TOMORROW block on /self-defense/session/[id] for parity with the player overlay and easier automation.

After fix, verify by reloading /self-defense/play/{sid} (advance to completion) AND /self-defense/session/{sid} (already-completed) — both should show focus_title + duration_min + intensity + focus_description fully populated. Re-run /api/self-defense/sessions/{sid}/uncomplete or generate a fresh session to retest the player path.
critical_code_review_comments: Type mismatch between sd-followup.ts (export type FollowUp = {focus_title, focus_description, duration_min, virtue, motto, journal_title, journal_body}) and the consumers in play/[id].tsx and session/[id].tsx that read focus, duration_minutes, intensity, discipline_practice. TypeScript should be flagging this (followUp.focus etc would be `never`/error under strict mode) — confirm tsconfig strictness; if strict, the build would fail and these references should be unreachable. If non-strict, this is a silent runtime bug.

prayer/[kind].tsx is well-structured: uses CHAPLETS registry, supports rosary mystery switcher, closes with deterministic Good Work card + Journal CTA. Good test coverage potential — testIDs 'prayer-hub-screen', 'prayer-card-{key}', 'prayer-step', 'prayer-good-work', 'prayer-journal', 'prayer-next', 'prayer-prev', 'prayer-done' all present and working.

MovementBreakdown.tsx is a clean text-first replacement — no SilhouetteAnimation imports anywhere, confirmed via grep. The component supports rest mode via isRest with testID='movement-breakdown-rest' and the main testID='movement-breakdown'.
Minor: sd-player play/[id].tsx warns on web with React Native '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — not blocking but worth a sweep.

Auth: app uses Authorization: Bearer <token> read from local secureStorage key 'sanctus_session_token'. Direct curl with that header works; injecting it via window.localStorage in playwright also works since storage.web.ts wraps localStorage.

rca_of_issue: Field-name drift between FollowUp type definition in /app/frontend/src/utils/sd-followup.ts and its two consumers. The util returns { focus_title, focus_description, duration_min, virtue, motto, journal_title, journal_body }, but the components read .focus, .duration_minutes, .intensity, .discipline_practice. Result: those four expressions evaluate to undefined and render as empty strings in <Text> nodes, leaving the FOR TOMORROW card visually incomplete (focus title row blank, 'Virtue · Discipline ·  min ·' meta row has empty duration and trailing dots, and the 'Discipline practice' section header is shown above empty body text). Reproduction: 1) Log in as ui_test_user_1, 2) navigate to /self-defense/play/{sid} for any session, 3) tap sd-player-next until sd-player-complete appears; OR 2) navigate to /self-defense/session/{sid} for any completed session. Mitigation: rename the JSX field accesses to match the util's actual keys (focus → focus_title, duration_minutes → duration_min, discipline_practice → focus_description); add an `intensity` field to FollowUp (derived from session.intensity_actual || session.plan.intensity) and return it from buildSelfDefenseFollowUp.
